tasks.title: First line
tasks.detail: Get every box from the inlet to the shipping bin. Walls are in the way.

tasks.title: Quality gate
tasks.detail: Some boxes leave filling underfilled. Ship the good ones, keep the bad ones out of the shipping bin.

tasks.title: Two lines, one dock
tasks.detail: Two filling lines feed one shipping dock. Line B sometimes double-packs. Merge both lines and ship only good boxes.

tasks.title: Bottling line (physics replay)
tasks.detail: A recorded MuJoCo run of a bottling line: checkweigher and reject pusher. No agent.
